MemeDef.description: The Riftworms are the life-givers and paved way for all that lives in the Hollows, they should be venerated.

FactionDef.Name: LocustFactionBase
FactionDef.ideoDescription:
From the Worms flesh, the Queen made strong drones.

From the Worms tunnels, Drones built the Nexus.

With the Worms power, Nexus defends the Queen.

And when man said to the Worms "what is your name?", the Worms answer, "My name is Horde, for we are many with the Trinity of Worms" - Ketor Droak - Kantus Scrolls

FactionDef.label: Locust Horde
FactionDef.description: Dwelling deep underneath the planets surface, the Locust Horde descends from ancient C.O.G gene splicing experiments involving the beasts of the Hollow and Immulsion Miners. The Horde believes that all of humanity owes them a blood debt, and as such are nearly impossible to reason with outside extreme circumstance.
